source: F. Terraneo, A. Leva, W. Fornaciari, 'An Open-hardware Platform for MPSoC Thermal Modeling', SAMOS 2019. Dataset: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.2871796 (CC-BY 4.0).
licence: CC-BY 4.0 -- redistributed here as a derived extract with attribution
what: Steady-state averages extracted from the raw 10 Hz traces by tools/ttc_extract.py: the last stretch of each powered phase, 400 samples (40 s). power_w is MEASURED per heater (V x I), temp_c is the measured diode temperature per cell, both in the dataset's cell order (row-major, top-left first, as in its 'experiments overview.txt'). The raw traces are not redistributed; they are at the DOI above.
geometry: 4 x 4 heater cells, 2 x 2 mm each, 8 x 8 mm array -- pinned by the 3D-ICE 3.0 paper's 5 W/cm2 uniform preheat against this dataset's 0.2 W baseline per element.
corrections_rule: a recording whose power/temperature correlation is below 0.5 is misaligned; it is kept only if a cyclic rotation of its diode channels lifts the correlation above 0.9, and the rotation is recorded here
